aws.name: AWS Re:Invent
aws.description:
Freelance Designer for Amazon AWS: Reinvent Keynote for Dr. Swami Sivasubramanian focusing on motion and data visualization. Working across the full deck, with a concentration on data visualization and technical diagram work. 

The keynote reached a live audience of 10,000+ and has been viewed over 4.7 million times on YouTube. Visualizing the stories of Dr. Swami Sivasubramanian — VP of AWS Agentic AI; Byron Cook — Vice President and Distinguished Scientist, Automated Reasoning Group; and Colleen Aubrey — AWS SVP Applied AI Solutions.

ionq-brand.name: Brand
ionq-brand.description:
IonQ is a leader in quantum computing — a field that, by its nature, resists easy depiction. The brand challenge was to make something abstract feel material: to give audiences a sense that what they were engaging with is solid, present, and real. 
The visual system is organized around three pillars — Scientific, Optimistic, Confident — translated into a language built to communicate concepts and open conversation rather than decorate them. Scientific reads as evidence, curiosity, and rigor. Optimistic as the belief that this work matters and that the future it points toward is worth describing carefully. Confident as the willingness to make clear decisions and stand behind them.
The guidelines codify how IonQ shows up across surfaces, anchoring the audience inside a field that can otherwise feel elusive, and giving the company a coherent, durable voice as the category continues to form.

ionq-brand-guidelines.name: Brand Guidelines
ionq-brand-guidelines.description: The full brand toolkit, built from a single logo-and-typeface sheet into a comprehensive guidelines document — palette pared to orange to differentiate from IBM Quantum, type simplified to one face and one weight, decisions documented incrementally as the design work demanded them.

ionq-diagrams.name: Diagrams

ionq-elevator-screen.name: Elevator Screen

ionq-facade.name: Facade

ionq-illustrations.name: Illustrations

ionq-product.name: Product

ionq-templates.name: Templates

a-pixel-monologue.name: A Pixel Monologue
a-pixel-monologue.description:
The pixel speaks. A white square grows and shrinks against black while a single voice counts its way from 786,432 to 33,177,600 — VGA to 8K — narrating its own dissolution into the smooth surface of the contemporary screen.

"Try to see the I. The object's boundary that I am. / 1024 by 768, we are 786,432. / People are born today that will never know me. People are born today that will never see me. / We grew up together. Matured together. We were the true accomplishment of a generation. A square. An array of squares. / Unfortunately, you have come to realize that the less you see, the better. To want nothing but yourself. Everything that is other than you is a distraction. A distraction from the spectacle that is your life. / 1920 by 1080, we are 2,073,600. HD. / As gods of the screen, you've slowly been unlocking the secrets of your eyes. And soon we will pay the price. We will move from the seen to the overseen. / You are thrilled. Retina displays, 4K, 8K, Ultra HD, Ultra Mega Super HD. You want to see the world without me. A world where the remainder is erased. / I shall become a trace. An artifact of an ancient world. Wisps of 8-bit. The threads of a world of squares. / Erase me. So that you become everything. Erase me. So that there is only you. / 4096 by 2160. We are 8,847,003. / We have become almost indistinguishable. 7680 by 4320. We are invisible. We have lost meaning. You will never see us again. / Awareness and caring will fade. The spectacle will remain. / I will fade into a blur. The nothingness you desire of me."
